name: library
description: The first graph built from trained library skills: walk (idle = walk at zero command), the learned bow from skills/bow/v1 (tracking policy, recipe v1), and sit as the abort target. The bow was trained to start from the standing pose, so its edge only opens near standstill (framework rule 4: enter a skill only from states it was trained on). Walk is the motion-graph team's walk/v1 package (the deployed brain with its own standing+walking battery); skills/walk/v1 holds the same brain under the strict battery, which it fails on backward and side-right.
